scores.tell: Hero and backdrop both at full chroma: neon pink, green and yellow buttons on a saturated blue body over hot orange. Little neutral to rest the eye.
Red-to-orange gradient backdrop with a peach floor, in a warm-biased palette. The grey legs give some neutral. Green seat is loud but similar to real cards.
Navy fur is near-neutral and the yellow stripes behind it are very loud. The pink ears and wood floor add more hue families. Slightly synthetic color.
Gold star on green sunburst is a real-card style color pairing. The ruby gem is a bit hot and the green is slightly neon.
Teal and cyan backdrop with a rainbow of light beams. Several hue families, and the blur colors are slightly fuzzy. Navy body is calm.
Teal wall behind orange-brown wood doors, a good complementary pairing. The sand floor is very flat and the wood chroma is a little uniform.
Turquoise water and orange deck are plausible. The purple snorkel tip is a slightly random extra accent. Blue mask is quite saturated.
Teal stripes and orange wood floor with copper and orange fittings. White tube gives neutral rest. Palette is close to the real cards. The blue lens is slightly neon.
Magenta backdrop with neon green leaves and orange trunk. Pushed to pure hues with little neutral. Chroma is the same everywhere.
Natural grass, sky and grey stone with muted neutrals, similar to the swing card. Greens are slightly uniform in hue.
